text: 1. Application form; 2. Copy of a valid passport, including name, passport number, expiration date and photo; 3. One photo that matches the passport photo; 4. Notarized highest education certificate. If the applicant is a student at school, he must also submit a certificate of enrollment issued by the school he is attending. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. 5. Study transcript. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. 6. Study or research plan. No less than 500 words, written in Chinese or English. 7. Letter of recommendation. Recommendation letters from two professors or associate professors, written in Chinese or English. 8. Applicants who are non-native English speakers provide proof of English proficiency, such as IELTS and TOEFL. 9. Indicate whether you are or not in China. If in China, please provide a copy of visa. 10. A copy of the "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" within the 6-month validity period. 11. Non-criminal certificate. A full body photo within 3 months and a full body video within 10 seconds. 12. Talents in arts, sports, etc. will be admitted first. Please provide corresponding certificates or performance videos.
